label: Command palette
ask: Press Enter to send this to omp as a message

terminal.title: omp terminal
terminal.hint: This is omp's terminal screen. Click or type to use it.
terminal.readOnly: This chat is open in another window. You can look, but only that window can type.
terminal.mirrorLabel: omp's screen. Keys you type go to omp.
terminal.disconnected: omp stopped. Restart it to use this screen again.

tsp.title: omp screen
tsp.hint: Choose an option or type in omp's controls. Escape dismisses the current menu.
tsp.mediaUnavailable: Media previews are not available in this preview.
tsp.rawOutput: omp output. Keys typed here go to omp.
tsp.hookReadOnly: This question is read-only in this preview. If it also appears in chat, answer it there.
tsp.retained: This omp screen has closed. Its output is read-only.
tsp.waiting: Waiting for semantic surfaces from omp…
tsp.unavailable: The semantic snapshot could not be loaded. Close and reopen this view to try again, or relaunch visual-omp without VOMP_TSP to return to the classic terminal.
tsp.preview: Developer preview: this inspector is read-only. Interactive terminal controls, image attachments, follow-up submission and !/$ shell or Python input are not available. Closing this view leaves omp unchanged.
tsp.negotiating: Negotiating the semantic preview with omp…
tsp.transitioning: Waiting for current semantic documents from omp…
tsp.exited: omp stopped. No live semantic documents are available.
tsp.stale: Retained documents are not current and are hidden.
tsp.recovery: Quit and relaunch visual-omp without VOMP_TSP to use the classic terminal and its controls.

palette.title: Search commands

terminal.title: Show omp terminal

split.title: Close split view

openSideBySide.title: Open side by side

nextWaiting.title: Go to next chat waiting for you

nextWaiting.none: No other chat is waiting for your answer.

reopenClosed.title: Reopen closed chat

reopenClosed.none: None of the chats you closed can be reopened. Each one is open again or its saved file was deleted.

zoomReset.title: Reset text size
